home.title: Calculate it once. Get it right.
home.subtitle: Free, no-nonsense calculators for construction crews, hobby makers and everyday projects. Every tool shows its formula, so you can trust the number before you buy.
home.popularSubtitle: The tools people reach for most often.
home.whySubtitle: No black boxes. Every result is transparent, editable and ready to take to the supplier.
home.why1Text: Change any input and the result updates immediately. Sensible defaults and unit toggles keep the maths honest.
home.why2Text: Each calculator explains the maths behind the number, with a worked example and practical ordering tips.
home.why3Text: Large touch targets, fast pages and a layout that works just as well on a phone at the job site.

home.step1Text: Browse by category or search for the job in front of you.
home.step2Text: Switch between metric and imperial, then add your dimensions.
home.step3Text: Read the result, check the formula and add a sensible waste allowance.
home.disclaimerText: Calculators are planning aids. Always verify quantities with your supplier or a qualified tradesperson before you order materials.

categoryDescriptions.construction: Work out concrete, paint, tile, lumber and roofing quantities before you buy. Each calculator shows the formula, a worked example, sensible waste allowances and practical ordering tips so you can check the number yourself.
categoryDescriptions.hobby: Plan yarn, resin, filament, brewing and other projects with calculators built for makers. See the formula, a worked example and tips on waste and material choices before you start cutting or mixing.
categoryDescriptions.universal: Convert length, weight, temperature, volume and other everyday units accurately. Pick your units, see the result instantly, and check the conversion formula and examples so the number makes sense.
